entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: The most ferocious gang of outlaws on Thunder Junction, led by the scorpion dragon Akul and based in Tarnation.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane where the Hellspurs operate.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: The scorpion dragon who led the Hellspurs.

entities.name: Twist Fandango
entities.description: A member of Akul's inner circle.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The Hellspurs' secret headquarters city built around the vault Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: The legendary treasure vault at the center of the plane.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: A gang that robbed Akul and the Hellspurs.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A member of Oko's gang whose nephew Tommy was hurt by Akul.

entities.name: Tommy
entities.description: Annie Flash's nephew, nearly killed by Akul's venom.

entities.name: Archie Dixon
entities.description: A courier killed when Akul's gang attacked a carriage transport.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: A company whose guards were killed and whose mercenaries later attacked Tarnation.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who infiltrated Tarnation and stole Akul's key.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: One of Oko's thieves, who challenged Akul to a duel and later mind controlled him.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A disguised planeswalker who was Oko's benefactor and took treasure from the vault.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A figure who defeated Akul in single combat.

events.summary: The Hellspurs build Tarnation to guard Maag Taranau, the legendary treasure vault.
events.quote: They built the town of Tarnation to guard it.

events.summary: After the Freestriders rob the Hellspurs, Akul tracks them down and attacks them even after they return the loot, nearly killing Tommy.
events.quote: Akul attacked them regardless, almost killing Annie Flash 's nephew Tommy with his venom

events.summary: Around 4564 AR Akul's gang attacks a carriage transport, killing the courier Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards to get the last key piece.
events.quote: killing a courier named Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards

events.summary: Oko and his gang infiltrate Tarnation, are captured, and Akul takes the final key piece; Kellan challenges Akul to a duel and Akul accepts.
events.quote: Akul was challenged to a duel by Kellan

events.summary: Sterling mercenaries tipped off by Oko attack Tarnation, Oko steals the key and the Hellspurs are defeated.
events.quote: The Hellspurs were ultimately defeated by the Sterling mercenaries.

events.summary: At the vault Oko opens it for Jace, who takes treasure and planeswalks away; Rakdos defeats Akul and Kellan mind controls him.
events.quote: Akul, for his part, was defeated by Rakdos in single combat

relations.quote: The Hellspurs were led by the scorpion dragon Akul
The gang is headquartered in the city of Tarnation
Akul pursued Oko to the vault

relations.note: opened the vault for his benefactor
relations.quote: Oko opened the vault for his benefactor, a disguised Jace Beleren
Akul, for his part, was defeated by Rakdos in single combat
